easyPrerequisites: Untapped creatures you control have total power 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Locus of Enlightenment using the Spacecraft's station ability by tapping a creature with power 1 or greater.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying its ability from step 1.
Resolve both Locus of Enlightenment abilities, putting a number of charge counters on it equal to twice the tapped creature's power.
If needed, repeat from step 1 until Locus of Enlightenment has three or more charge counters on it.
Activate Locus of Enlightenment using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
